$comment: Recurring rules: the editor (app/recurring/[id].tsx), the confirm sheet (confirm.tsx), the due queue (due.tsx) and cadence labels (src/lib/repeat.ts).

title.note: Title of the unit step of a custom cadence.

daily.message: {count, plural, =1 {Every day} one {Every # day} other {Every # days}}

weekly.message: {count, plural, =1 {Every week} one {Every # week} other {Every # weeks}}

monthly.message: {count, plural, =1 {Every month} one {Every # month} other {Every # months}}

yearly.message: {count, plural, =1 {Every year} one {Every # year} other {Every # years}}

repeat.customSubtitle: Any number of days, weeks, months or years

amountA11y.note: VoiceOver; amount with its currency code.

summary.note: Under the amount: "every month · next 22 Sep at 11:17". repeat is a lowercased cadence label.

fromTx.title: Start from a transaction
fromTx.subtitle: Search your history; amount, category, tags and period are filled in

seen.note: How often a series was found in history; repeat is a lowercased cadence label ("every month").

titleRow.note: Row and field: the rule's name (payee).

noteHint: Added to every transaction this rule posts

next.note: Row: the date of the next occurrence.

reminder.title: Reminder
reminder.daysBefore: {count, plural, one {# day before} other {# days before}}

posting.title: Posting
posting.autoSubtitle: Leaves your account by itself; added on the day
posting.manualSubtitle: Day or amount varies; Kopiyka asks first
posting.autoLate: Automatically, once the charge is late
posting.askLate: Asks once the charge is late

match.amountHint: The exact amount — pick a payment to match its name too
match.title: Recognise this charge

body.note: name is the shop as the bank prints it.

manyDue.message: {count, plural, one {# occurrence due ({from} → {to})} other {# occurrences due ({from} → {to})}}

due.note: After the account name and " · ". Lowercase.

confirmSheet.skipHint: Skipping moves the next date forward without adding a transaction.

due.title: Recurring due
due.intro: {count, plural, one {One payment is waiting on you. Post it once it has actually left your account, or skip it for this time.} other {# payments are waiting on you. Post each once it has actually left your account, or skip it for this time.}}

introSum.message: {count, plural, one {One payment is waiting on you — <sum>total</sum>. Post it once it has actually left your account, or skip it for this time.} other {# payments are waiting on you — <sum>total</sum>. Post each once it has actually left your account, or skip it for this time.}}
introSum.note: <sum> is replaced by the total amount; its text is ignored.

due.emptyHint: Manual recurring payments show up here on the day they are due.
due.waitingIntro: {count, plural, one {Nothing added for this one yet.} other {Nothing added for these yet.}} Your bank’s notification settles it; if none comes in time, it returns here to be posted.

waitingIntroSum.message: {count, plural, one {Nothing added for this one yet — <sum>total</sum>.} other {Nothing added for these yet — <sum>total</sum>.}} Your bank’s notification settles it; if none comes in time, it returns here to be posted.
waitingIntroSum.note: <sum> is replaced by the total amount; its text is ignored.

due.postAllA11y: {count, plural, one {Post # due payment} other {Post all # due payments}}
due.skipTitle: {count, plural, one {Skip this one?} other {Skip # occurrences?}}

skipBody.message: No transaction is added for {name}; the rule moves on to its next date.

due.skipBodyNoName: No transaction is added for this payment; the rule moves on to its next date.

fallbackTitle.note: Row title for a rule with no title and no category.

due.deadlinePosts: {count, plural, one {Posts if nothing arrives within a day} other {Posts if nothing arrives within # days}}
due.deadlineBack: {count, plural, one {Comes back here if nothing arrives within a day} other {Comes back here if nothing arrives within # days}}
due.dueSince: {count, plural, one {# due since {date}} other {# due since {date}}}
